status: draft v0 (C1); needs review by the team science lead
scoringRule: Values were assigned by judgment (C1 draft), guided by three factors: the weight of the highest objective served, uniqueness (few other stations give the same measurement), and crew-actionability (can a suited crew make the measurement in 10-30 min). No formula was fitted. The science lead should re-score before the final pitch. This is a transparent team heuristic, not a calibrated model.

goals.statement: Understand how Mars' ancient groundwater shaped Mount Sharp, and for how long it stayed habitable.
sources: Curiosity blog sols 4618-4619: branching boxwork structures are likely groundwater-related. https://science.nasa.gov/blog/curiosity-blog-sols-4618-4619-the-boxwork-structures-continue-to-call-to-us

Curiosity blog sols 4649-4654: hypothesis that fluid cementation formed the ridges and erosion removed the softer rock between. https://science.nasa.gov/blog/curiosity-blog-sols-4649-4654-ridges-hollows-and-nodules-oh-my

goals.statement: Choose and document the best samples for analysis now and for potential return (Mars Sample Return planning).
sources: Curiosity blog sols 4867-4872: Atacama chosen as drillable, representative layered-sulfate target. https://science.nasa.gov/blog/curiosity-blog-sols-4867-4872-sand-fill-in-antofagasta-crater-and-finding-our-next-drill-target
Team design: sample-selection stations are scored for representativeness and crew-actionability. No specific NASA sample-return requirement is cited here (not sourced).

goals.statement: Characterize the stratigraphic record and exotic material on Mount Sharp (units, contacts, debris-flow deposits, float rocks).
sources: Curiosity blog sols 4804-4811: final boxwork phase examines where the boxwork unit meets neighbouring units. https://science.nasa.gov/blog/curiosity-blog-sols-4804-4811-kicking-off-the-final-phase-of-boxwork-exploration

objectives.statement: Determine whether boxwork ridges and hollows differ in mineralogy, chemistry and texture, and so how boxwork formed.
objectives.rationale: Ridges and hollows show only subtle chemical differences (blog sols 4695-4701), so mineralogy from a hollow/ridge drill pair is the discriminator (blog sols 4689-4694, 4716-4722).

measurements.crew_action: Photograph ridge crest, hollow wall and floor with scale and sun-angle metadata
Mark and describe bedrock texture and nodules at contact

objectives.statement: Map fluid-flow evidence (veins, polygons, nodules, fracture fills) as groundwater pathways.
objectives.rationale: Polygons seen on the block beside Valle de la Luna, previously known only from layered sulfate units, not hollow floors (blog sols 4743-4749); branching structures likely groundwater-related (blog 4618-4619).

measurements.crew_action: Image polygon fractures and veins at 1 m and 10 cm scale

objectives.statement: Record stratigraphy and unit contacts (boxwork vs light-toned layered unit; sulfate layers; Gediz Vallis ridge deposits).
objectives.rationale: Contacts and butte layering constrain relative age (blog 4825-4831, 4867-4872); Gediz Vallis ridge deposits are a recognised long-sought target (blog 3930-3931).

measurements.crew_action: Panoramic imaging of exposed layers with a documented heading and position

objectives.statement: Select representative, drillable, well-documented sample sites and record their context.
objectives.rationale: A hollow floor is usually sand-covered, so drillable hollow rock is scarce (blog 4689-4694); Atacama was picked as drillable and representative (blog 4867-4872).

measurements.crew_action: Judge drillability (flat, hard, uncovered bedrock), photograph workspace, tag candidate

objectives.statement: Identify exotic or float material (possible meteorite, ridge float rocks) for rapid classification.
objectives.rationale: Thola may be a meteorite, possibly a chondrite; chemistry and reflectance decide if it is native to Mars (blog 4825-4831). Classification is unconfirmed.

measurements.crew_action: Photograph, scale and describe colour/texture of dark float rock; no sampling without approval
